name: Video project
description: Root-capable two-phase production: briefing → research → WHAT brainstorm (brainstorm → brainstorm-select) → HOW brainstorm (brainstorm-how → brainstorm-how-select). The HOW winner (brainstorm-how-select, plansProduction) materializes the rest of the spine — script → moodboard → storyboard → board → build → assemble → polish → final review — as siblings; the chosen approach defines it, so it is no longer a static checklist.
